description: A triangular tent with a small entrance and pennant stands in front of a person. The person's circular head and rounded upper body remain visible at the right.
A person runs toward the right with the torso leaning forward and both arms bent. One leg extends behind, while the other bends downward beneath a round detached head.
A pickup truck faces right with a long low cargo bed and a raised cab. Two circular wheels interrupt the flat lower edge beneath its unmarked body.
A pickup truck faces left beneath a row of three pointed pine trees. The low cargo bed extends behind the cab, supported by two round wheels below.
A caliper has two opposing jaws extending left from a long upright beam. Its upper jaw is squared, while the lower jaw curves outward beneath a short horizontal measuring edge.
A rectangular video camera has two circular side details and a flared lens at the right. A top handle and raised capsule-shaped microphone project above its body.
A caboose has a broad projecting roof with a small raised section on top. Two square windows sit near its sides above a straight chassis and two rounded wheels.
A curved window segment has a broad arched top and a shallower concave lower edge. A diagonal wiper arm crosses it from a circular pivot below.
A single outlined triangle points to the right with a vertical left edge. Its three corners are softly rounded, and the broad enclosed interior is completely empty.
A scissor jack has a diamond-shaped lifting frame between a broad base and small top saddle. A horizontal screw crosses its middle, ending in a circular handle at the right.
Two lit candles stand on a shared curved holder with a narrow stem and flat foot. A small rounded loaf with two scoring marks rests beside the holder.
A plain circular clock face contains one straight upright hand extending above its center. The outer ring is unbroken, with no numerals, tick marks or second hand visible.
A hen faces right with a pointed beak, small rounded crest and hanging wattle. Its curved body rises into a tail at the left above one visible thin foot.
A triangular tent rests on a straight ground line with a smaller triangular entrance. Two detached horizontal wind lines sit above its peak, spanning slightly more than its upper width.
A candy cane has a long upright shaft and a broad rounded hook bending left. Diagonal stripe divisions run along the shaft and continue around the curved crown.

concept: Cat Bust with Two Fur Patches
description: A front facing cat has pointed ears, tiny eyes and a small angular nose and mouth. Curved fur patches cover one side of its face and the opposite shoulder.
A round headed figure wears a broad cape that descends diagonally toward the lower left. Another triangular section billows to the right with a curved fluttering lower edge.
A tall narrow tower has a pointed triangular roof above a plain rectangular shaft. A small arched window sits near the top, with short horizontal roof and base projections.
A broad upright triangle is divided into three horizontal tiers by two straight lines. The lowest section is widest, while the upper section narrows to a sharp point.
A long cacao pod has pointed ends and broad curved sides. Two internal ribs bow outward from top to bottom, while a short curved stem rises above the upper tip.
A uniformed cadet faces forward in a flat topped cap with a curved visor. A plain face sits above a round collar, central shirt seam and short chest mark.
A campus building has a raised central section topped by a triangular roof. An arched doorway and upper arched window align between two lower wings with square windows.
A short drainage channel has two thick raised sidewalls and a recessed center. Its rounded front cross-section forms a broad U, with a straight rear edge across the opening.
A Y-shaped connector branches upward into two diagonal arms ending in outlined diamonds. Its short vertical lower stem terminates in a larger circle, with all three shapes left empty.
A bridge spans three rounded arches beneath a long straight deck line. Two parallel rows of smooth waves pass under the arches, separating the structure from the water below.
A broad domed cave outline rises from a flat base. A smaller arch opens inside it, leaving a thick surrounding band that narrows toward the curved crown.
A sun lounger appears in side view with a tall backward sloping backrest and long horizontal seat. Its foot end curves downward above two short angled supporting legs.
A small caravan has a rounded rectangular body, one side window and a tall door. A single large wheel projects beneath it, with a short tow bar extending right.
A front facing car sits inside a shelter with a broad triangular roof and two upright posts. The car has a rounded windshield, paired headlights and two short wheels.
A side view car sits beneath three teardrop-shaped water drops. A short overhead bar with a central stem marks the spray source above the rounded vehicle and two wheels.
A car faces forward with two small person busts visible through its broad windshield. Round headlights and short wheels sit beneath the plain rectangular front body.
A rounded square candy is covered across its top by a thick glaze. The coating hangs down in several uneven rounded drips over the otherwise plain front.
A carrot tapers diagonally toward a pointed lower-left tip. Three short curved root marks cross its body, and three pointed leaves fan from the short stem at upper right.
A chalice has a broad flat rim and deep rounded bowl. A narrow central stem descends from the bowl and flares outward into a wide flat foot.
A crested bird faces right with a short triangular beak and tall swept crown. Its curved wing leads into a long diagonal tail above a thin bent leg.
Two long rounded bandage strips cross diagonally to form an X. Straight internal lines remain visible through the overlap, creating a central diamond between the four rounded ends.
A delivery truck faces right with a large rectangular cargo box behind a smaller angular cab. Two round wheels overlap its lower edge beneath a sloping front windshield.
A chair sits behind a wide desk with a shallow trapezoidal top and two long legs. Its curved backrest rises above the tabletop, while the seat and legs show below.
A broad outlined arrow points straight down with a long vertical shaft and two diagonal head arms. Rounded tips and a curved lower point soften its otherwise angular form.
A chandelier hangs from a shallow ceiling cup on a straight stem. Two curved arms support pointed bulbs at equal heights, with a small diamond pendant below the center.
A decorative chandelier has four curved arms spreading from a suspended central stem. Teardrop lights sit above their ends, and three further drops hang beneath the sweeping lower arms.
A long rug appears in perspective with a straight upper panel and outward spreading lower section. A horizontal fold line crosses its middle, and short fringes line the front edge.
A rounded square is divided into four matching cells by one vertical and one horizontal line. Both dividers cross at the center and meet the continuous outer border.
A cauliflower floret has a broad lobed crown above a thick branching stalk. Short internal curves mark the clustered florets, while the stalk narrows into a flat base.
A hand grips a pointed carving tool angled down toward the left. Its blade meets a low block whose upper edge curves upward into a rounded rectangular end.
An open hand reaches upward with curved fingers and an extended thumb. A plain round ball floats just above the palm, separated from the fingertips by clear space.
A hand wraps around the left side of a tall tapered cup. Its thumb points upward while three curved fingers overlap the cup below an open oval rim.
Two open hands rise symmetrically beneath a large round casino chip. The chip has an empty central circle surrounded by a broad rim divided into radial sections.
A pendant lamp hangs from a straight cord beneath a horizontal ceiling line. Its wide sloping shade surrounds a rounded bulb, with a small rectangular fitting above.
A horse faces left with an upright neck and several angular legs. A small carriage attaches behind it, with a high rounded back and one large spoked wheel.
A slender chili pepper bends from a rounded upper shoulder toward a sharp lower-left tip. A short curved stem rises from the top of its plain elongated body.
A house faces forward beneath a broad pitched roof with projecting eaves. A tall rounded doorway sits left of a small square window above a straight ground line.
A human ear has a long rounded outer rim narrowing into a soft lower lobe. Curved internal folds curl inward around the central opening, with small breaks along the outline.
A broad L-shaped carpenter square has straight parallel edges and a crisp inner corner. A diagonal joint crosses the outer corner where its vertical and horizontal arms meet.
A wide outlined arrow points left along a horizontal shaft. Its two diagonal head arms end in rounded tips, matching the curved tail and softened point.
A single straight vertical line stands alone from near the top to near the bottom. It has no horizontal branches, surrounding frame, decoration or attached shapes.
A shallow litter tray has a wide open top and curved projecting rim ends. A slotted scoop leans out to the upper right on a long rounded handle.
A long robe faces forward with a small rounded neckline and straight central opening. Loose sleeves extend diagonally from the shoulders, while the body tapers gently toward its flat hem.
A map pin has a broad rounded head tapering into a sharp downward point. A circular opening sits inside the upper portion, leaving a wide uninterrupted outline around it.
A domed ceiling fixture hangs from a short vertical stem. Three round lights descend below its flat lower edge, one on a straight central cord and two on curved side arms.
A rounded sack has a thick rolled rim across its open top. A pointed mound of sugar rises above the opening, while the bag widens toward its curved base.
Four outlined card suits form a loose square: diamond at upper left, club at upper right, spade below left and heart below right. Each symbol remains separate.
A round target contains two inner circles centered within a larger outer ring. Four short crosshair strokes point inward across the middle ring from the cardinal directions.
A shopping cart has a broad sloping basket on a bent frame. A short handle extends left at the top, while two separate circular wheels sit beneath the base.
A cash register has a sloping keypad covered with short key marks above a broad base. A raised rear housing carries a slot and a small display on a stem.
A wide outlined arrow points right with a long horizontal shaft. Its diagonal head arms spread upward and downward, ending in rounded tips that match the curved tail.
A rectangular mat lies partly unrolled, with one edge curled into a large cylinder. A spiral marks the near end of the roll beside the broad flat remainder.
A helmeted head faces right beneath a high sweeping crest. The helmet has a projecting brow, long cheek guard and flared rear neck protection around the plain facial profile.
A tall bell jar has straight sides rising into a smooth domed top. It rests on a wide low base with rounded upper corners, enclosing a completely empty interior.

concept: Right Facing Fish with Two Fins
description: A fish faces right with an oval body, forked tail and small mouth notch. A curved gill marks the head, while separate fins project above and below.
A pottery vase has a flared open lip above a narrow curved neck. Its rounded shoulders swell into a broad body that tapers down to a short flat base.
A caterpillar consists of five overlapping round segments curving upward toward the right. Its raised head carries two short curved antennae, while the lower body remains plain.
A stylized octopus has a large domed head narrowing beside two tiny upright eyes. Several long arms curl outward and upward beneath it, with gaps separating the lower contours.
A long writing stick angles toward the lower left with a beveled pointed end and rounded upper corners. A short horizontal mark lies separately below its tip.
A rounded square cell encloses a large circular nucleus. Four small elongated organelles angle inward around the nucleus, positioned near the corners within the otherwise empty cell boundary.
A squeeze bottle has sloping shoulders and a broad rounded base beneath a short screw collar. A narrow pointed nozzle rises above it, with a vertical oval label on the front.
Six rounded eggs form a compact triangular stack with one at the top. Their overlapping outlines create small angular gaps between the upper pair and the three lower eggs.
A broad outlined arrow points upward from a long vertical shaft. Two diagonal arms form its head, with rounded outer tips and a smoothly curved upper point.
A tall wine bottle with a narrow neck and broad label band stands beside a stemmed glass. A horizontal liquid line crosses the glass above its rounded bowl and flat foot.
A broad rounded building facade has three small arches across an upper level. A larger central arched doorway rises from the base beneath a straight horizontal dividing line.
A shallow oval bowl sits below several overlapping elongated forms, including a diagonal strip and two horizontal rounded pieces. A curved line projects from the cluster's right side.
A rectangular briefcase has rounded lower corners and a broad folding top flap. The flap slopes gently toward a central rounded clasp, leaving the front panel plain.
Two hands meet diagonally in a firm handshake with wrists extending toward opposite upper corners. Four rounded fingers wrap around the clasp, while long finger divisions cross the other hand.
A wheeled canister vacuum has a domed top and small neck fitting. A high curved hose arches to the right and descends into a broad floor nozzle.

concept: Low Vacuum with Tall Curved Hose
description: A low canister vacuum has one large side wheel and a rounded body. Its hose rises in a tall loop before descending vertically to a small right-facing floor head.
An upright vacuum canister has a rounded top, circular button and horizontal lower seam. A looping hose rises above it and drops to a wide flared cleaning head.
A big cat faces left with a rounded ear, blunt muzzle and small nose. A curved cheek marking drops from the eye area toward the jaw above a strong neck.
Two equal straight diagonal strokes meet at a low central point. Their upper ends spread widely apart, forming a plain open downward chevron without a stem or surrounding border.
A child stretches one arm diagonally upward to the right and the other downward to the left. A round head sits above a plain body with one leg bent outward.
A child sits in a deep car seat with a high curved back and broad base. The round head floats above a bent arm and legs projecting to the right.
A chimpanzee face has a broad rounded head between two circular ears. An inner heart-shaped brow flows into a large projecting rounded muzzle, with no separate facial features.
A broad oval choker band is shown in perspective with a curved lower edge. A short central connector suspends a plain circular pendant beneath the front of the band.
Two flared bells lean outward beneath a large tied bow. Pointed ribbon tails hang between them, and rounded clappers project below the overlapping lower edges of the bells.
A Christmas tree has three stacked triangular branch tiers above a straight trunk. A square gift sits to its right, divided by crossed ribbons and topped with two bow strokes.
A small church faces forward beneath a pitched roof carrying a cross at its peak. A tall arched doorway occupies the center of its otherwise plain rectangular facade.
A nearly complete circular ring has a small opening at its top. The smooth curve remains continuous around both sides and the bottom, with no interior markings.
A circular saw blade has a ring of sharply pointed asymmetric teeth around its edge. A small round mounting hole sits at the center of the plain inner disc.
A circus tent has a pointed roof with a scalloped lower edge and a small pennant at its peak. Straight sidewalls frame a tall rounded central entrance below.
A movie camera has two matching circular reels attached above a rounded rectangular body. A short flared lens projects right, while the broad side panel remains plain.
A large rounded rectangular screen hangs above two matching chairs. Each chair has a rounded backrest, short armrests and straight legs, with a horizontal seat line across the middle.
A tapered bucket has a wide rolled rim and rounded lower corners. A broad cloth folds over the left side of the rim, hanging down with one curved crease.
A clothes hanger has a broad triangular body with rounded lower corners and a straight bottom bar. A curved hook rises from a short upright neck at the center.
